items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmie Cheatham was one of the trombone players. It was an all-star band... I conducted that whole show.

ctx.x: Jon – the lead trumpet player on “The Tonight Show.” Jon [?Faddis]. Anyway, Ray Brown was the bass player. Joe Pass was the guitar player. Don Abney was the piano player. Jimmie Cheatham was one of the trombone players. It was an all-star band. All the violins and everything. 40 men. I conducted that whole show. I had a real problem playing drums.
So your role was musical director? And conductor?
